steps.step1: Talosaga lau tusi faamaonia o le fanau mai
steps.step2: Talosaga lau pepa o le Saogalemu Lautele
steps.step3: Amata le talosaga ID a le setete
steps.step4: Ia faatulaga ni sini ma lau pule
steps.step5: Fuafua le auala e te toe foʻi ai i lou aiga
steps.step6: Faatulaga se fesootaʻiga lagolago e tasi
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Siaki pepa ma aso atofaina e tatala ai oe
steps.step10: Faamaonia le aso ma tuutuuga o lau asiasiga muamua
steps.step13: Ia maua se telefoni, imeli ma le initaneti e leai se totogi
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: Faʻafesoʻotaʻi auaunaga i le lotoifale mo le toe ulufale mai
steps.step16: Ia iloa tulaga o le vaavaaiga
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step18: Siaki le tulaga o lau laisene avetaavale
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step20: Ia aumai au faamaumauga o lou soifua mālōlōina
steps.step22: Tusi se taimi i le fomaʻi
steps.step23: Faatulaga se taimi mo se suʻesuʻega i le mafaufau
steps.step24: Ia faia se iloiloga o le faaaogāina o fualaau faasāina
steps.step27: Talosaga atu i tagata faigaluega e maua ai le avanoa lona lua
steps.step28: Iloilo aʻoaʻoga po o tusi faamaonia
steps.step29: Tatala se teugatupe i le faletupe ma fuafua se tupe e faaaogā
steps.step30: Ia amata ona toe faaleleia lau aitalafu
steps.step31: Toe fesootaʻi atu i le aiga, ma taulimaina le tausiga o le fanau pe afai e talafeagai
steps.step32: Faatulaga se faasologa masani i aso taʻitasi
steps.step33: Ia faatulaga se sini mo se taimi umi, ma faamanatu le 90 aso ua e ausia ai
